predecessor.information_change: Replace unjustified parent-boundary polarity with a two-polarity quotient. Only ranks invariant to axis reversal may commit.

selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first eligible scene.

frozen_algorithm.representation: parent-normalized PCA lattice retaining both axis polarities; complete public ordinal inventory supplies rank cardinality but not target membership
frozen_algorithm.unique_commit_rule: Commit only when forward rank and reversed rank identify the same candidate; otherwise preserve SC31 and request an orientation observation.

forbidden_after_source_access: choose a PCA sign using task target IDs, sibling target order, or evaluator output
change ordinal parsing, lattice, pitch, or residual thresholds
read description annot_id values or target membership
run SC31 or quotient selector outcomes during admission
reorder candidates or skip an eligible scene
claim_boundary: Outcome-blind provider-public admission for orientation-quotient ordinal grounding. Public task text may establish a complete rank inventory and privileged proposal geometry may establish an unoriented lattice; target IDs and selector outcomes remain sealed. Passing is not algorithm success, RGB proposal performance, live orientation, reachability, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety evidence.
